description: Defines the SwabbleConfig struct for application configuration, including nested structs for audio, wake, hook, logging, transcripts, and speech settings; also includes ConfigLoader for loading and saving configuration files.

classes.name: SwabbleConfig
classes.description: A struct holding various configuration categories such as audio, wake, hook, logging, transcripts, and speech, with default values and a static default path.

classes.name: ConfigError
classes.description: An error enum representing missing configuration error.

classes.name: ConfigLoader
classes.description: A static utility for loading and saving the SwabbleConfig to and from JSON files with specified paths.

methods.name: load(at:)
methods.description: Loads a SwabbleConfig from a specified URL, throwing error if the file does not exist or decoding fails.

methods.name: save(_:at:)
methods.description: Saves a SwabbleConfig to a specified URL, creating necessary directories, encoding the data as JSON.
